responsibility: This file implements the compiler-wide interned-name table used by mc. It stores unique strings in a binary tree keyed by lexical order, assigns stable numeric Name identifiers, keeps a parallel index for reverse key-to-string lookup, and provides helpers for copying text out, length queries, case-insensitive comparison, and direct C-string access. It is the fundamental name-canonicalization layer beneath symbolKey, decl, diagnostics, and parsing.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for name interning, with the binary tree, reverse key index, allocation, comparisons, and case-insensitive matching code. Unlike nameKey.def, it provides the underlying data structures and procedure bodies rather than just the exported API.
